definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine dealing with the diagnosis and non-surgical treatment of diseases affecting internal organs. Also refers to the department in a hospital or clinic.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}をひいたので{内科|ないか}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the internal medicine clinic because I caught a cold.

examples.japanese: {内科|ないか}の{先生|せんせい}に{診|み}てもらった。
examples.english: I was examined by an internist.

examples.japanese: この{病院|びょういん}の{内科|ないか}は{評判|ひょうばん}がいい。
examples.english: This hospital's internal medicine department has a good reputation.

notes:
HOSPITAL DEPARTMENTS (common):
- {内科|ないか} (internal medicine)
- {外科|げか} (surgery)
- {小児科|しょうにか} (pediatrics)
- {産婦人科|さんふじんか} (obstetrics & gynecology)
- {眼科|がんか} (ophthalmology)
- {耳鼻科|じびか} (ENT - ear, nose, throat)
- {皮膚科|ひふか} (dermatology)
- {精神科|せいしんか} (psychiatry)

SUBSPECIALTIES:
- {消化器|しょうかき}{内科|ないか} (gastroenterology)
- {循環器|じゅんかんき}{内科|ないか} (cardiology)
- {呼吸器|こきゅうき}{内科|ないか} (pulmonology)

CONTRAST:
- {内科|ないか} - treats with medication, non-invasive
- {外科|げか} - treats with surgery
